motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Hover lifts 2px, active flattens. 100ms. No bounce/elastic.

dos: Do keep one primary action per screen.
Do pair every red/green signal with text + icon.
Do use Baloo 2 + Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese coverage.
donts: Don't use gray-on-accent or unverified white-on-accent text.
Don't use alert()/confirm(); use inline nb-card errors.
Don't add bounce/elastic easing or decorative glass.
Don't edit source via PowerShell Get/Set-Content (mojibake).
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper bench with white cards
narrative.overview: A tactile training ground that feels like a well-worn lab bench: cream paper, chunky black frames, hard offset shadows that press down when touched.

rules.body: Yellow = focus, blue = action, lime = correct, red = wrong. Never swap jobs to decorate.
rules.name: The One-Job Rule

rules.body: Every surface has a 2-3px ink border; depth is offset shadow, never blur glow.
rules.name: The Ink Rule

rules.body: One display element per viewport wins.
rules.name: The One Winner Rule

rules.body: If it looks pressable it must press.
rules.name: The Press Rule
